import re,html,json,pathlib,hashlib
out={}
for n in ('295','365'):
    p=pathlib.Path('products/research/go-hybrid-payout/discussion-%s.html'%n)
    raw=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8',errors='replace')
    t=re.search(r'<title>(.*?)</title>',raw,re.S)
    body=re.sub(r'<script.*?</script>|<style.*?</style>|<svg.*?</svg>',' ',raw,flags=re.S)
    links=sorted(set(re.findall(r'href="(https?://[^"]*(?:basescan|etherscan|blockscout|tx/)[^"]*)"',body)))
    addrs=sorted(set(re.findall(r'0x[0-9a-fA-F]{40,64}',body)))
    times=re.findall(r'datetime="([^"]+)"',body)
    txt=html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>','\n',body))
    lines=[re.sub(r'\s+',' ',l).strip() for l in txt.split('\n')]
    lines=[l for l in lines if l]
    i=0
    for k,l in enumerate(lines):
        if t and l[:20]==html.unescape(t.group(1)).strip()[:20]: i=k;break
    out[n]={'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'title':html.unescape(t.group(1)).strip() if t else None,'tx_links':links,'hex_ids':addrs,'datetimes':times[:60],'text':'\n'.join(lines)[:60000]}
d=pathlib.Path('products/research/go-hybrid-payout');d.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
(d/'extract.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=1,ensure_ascii=False))
for n in out:
    o=out[n];print(n,o['title'],len(o['text']),o['tx_links'],o['hex_ids'][:10])
